text:
Sam Holt: VERA Health asked to run a 6-week POC to validate vera-40b-clin-custom for discharge summaries + coding. Their must-haves: Private/VPC option, per-customer KMS (BYOK), ability to disable request logs, and a hard NTE for the trial. They also attached a 47-question security questionnaire.
Priya Menon: Thanks. Any artifacts or HF/S3 paths? Typical input/output sizes?
Sam Holt: HF link (access via NDA): hf://vera/vera-40b-clin-custom. They said avg input ~2k tokens, outputs ~300-600, and some stitched notes up to ~12k. Concerned about hallucinations so want regression checks + a short eval harness.
Alex Romero: Ops notes: 12k contexts -> needs interleaved KV + chunking; consider kv-prune LRU and prefix caching. Variant plan: vera-40b-q4_k_m-kv for quality and vera-12b-slim for latency fallback. Try an experimental vera-40b-int8-kv to measure mem/latency tradeoffs. For Dedicated sizing I'd propose 4x A100-80GB with kv shards for the quality route.
Tara Singh: Legal asks: they require SOC2 + DPA + explicit non-training clause and deletion attestation. I'll need the filled security questionnaire to start the DPA review. Also confirm BYOK/HSM path and whether we can toggle logging.
ops-bot: Ticket created POC-10234: "VERA vera-40b-clin-custom POC - BYOK, HIPAA, perf". Assigned: eng-runtime, sales-eng, legal. Link: <internal/POC-10234>.
Alex Romero: Quick SE runbook for the team:
```
# inspect model
redwoodctl model inspect --model hf://vera/vera-40b-clin-custom
# perf baseline
redwoodctl perf run --model vera-40b-clin-custom --quant q4_k_m --kv interleaved --seq-len 12288 --batch 1
# try int8-kv
redwoodctl perf run --model vera-40b-clin-custom --quant int8 --kv interleaved --seq-len 6144 --batch 1
```
Alex Romero: Also check tokenizer special tokens and eos/pad mapping because truncation has bitten us on large clinical prompts: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('Patient: John Doe
Note: ...'))"`
Sam Holt: For quality/regression: they want rouge/f1 vs their golden set and hallucination probe (10% sample). SEs, can you run a short eval (200 examples) and report deltas vs their baseline?
Priya Menon: Will queue eval + perf. Also will run both Triton and XLA paths — this family historically had a custom gated activation that slows Triton. I'll post p50/p95 and mem usage to the ticket.
Tara Singh: On BYOK: confirm whether customer can supply a key via KMS in Private, and whether Dedicated can do customer-managed keys in a VPC-peered setup. Ops please confirm before I start legal intake.
Alex Romero: Recommended routing plan: start with Dedicated behind VPC peering (100% for validation), then canary 5% to vera-40b-q4_k_m-kv cluster with automatic fallback to 12b-slim if latency >450ms or error rate spikes. Add per-route cost tags so the POC billing can be reconciled to the NTE.
ops-bot: Provisioning note: can set up 4x A100-80GB Dedicated pool for initial runs; if mem/kv-shard pressure high we can move to inter-node KV sharding. Will enable prefix caching and kv-prune LRU by default for the POC.
Sam Holt: Pricing ask from VERA: provide a 6-week not-to-exceed cap plus two alternatives: (A) usage-only hosted with HIPAA uplift, (B) 6-week Dedicated reservation w/ credits and burst to hosted, (C) Private deployment quote (longer lead + infra fee). Can finance sketch both commit and pure usage numbers?
Priya Menon: I'll produce a blended estimate based on perf token throughput, expected token volume (they estimate up to 3M input tokens/week), and instance-hours for the Dedicated pool. Will post by EOD Wed.
Tara Singh: Legal checklist: once questionnaire is filled we need: SOC2 artifact, DPA signature, BYOK confirmation, non-training clause, deletion attestation language. Also request a subprocessor list disclosure for their procurement.
Alex Romero: Small note on tokenizer/chunking: for stitched 12k contexts, we should also validate our prefix caching for repeated patient metadata — that often brings p95 down significantly. Add a coverage test for repeated headers in the eval harness.
Sam Holt: I'll send them the security questionnaire and sample prompts today and schedule a kickoff call for Thu 10am ET. SEs / Ops — can you aim to have initial perf + a 200-example regression run before the call?
Priya Menon: Will do. Queuing perf + eval now.
ops-bot: Perf jobs queued under POC-10234. Results will be attached to the ticket when complete.
Tara Singh: I'll hold off on legal upload until we get the filled questionnaire and BYOK confirmation.
Sam Holt: Thanks team :rocket: — adding VERA contacts to the thread and sharing the calendar invite.
